name: System tray (no drawer)
author: Raymond Maung
description: Stock tray fork: pinned items only — no hover drawer, no chevron, and dropbox/localsend suppressed outright. Replaces omarchy.tray in the layout (a third-party plugin cannot claim the omarchy.* id, and third-party widgets/ subdirs are never scanned, so editing the raymond.bar clone's copy did nothing).
